about: The crypt's north-south bridge, 128 px long (docs/milestones/connected-biomes.md, CB11): the crypt bridge (crypt_bridge.shape.json) turned to run north to south, so a room's north and south sockets join too and a biome's map branches off its way. Its floor a 64 px band of the causeway's stones (content/grounds/causeway), its sides a broken lip (crypt_edge) and an invisible wall. Its ends run to the template's edge, where its two sockets are. tools/ground_shape.py draws crypt_bridge_v128_ground.tscn and its art from this.
